plans.metaDescription: Manage subscription plans, pricing tiers, and feature matrices for the Rawafid merchant platform.

hero.title: Plan management
hero.subtitle: Shape the offers merchants see on signup and billing — localized names, volume tiers, and feature limits in one catalog.

toolbar.title: Filter catalog
toolbar.hint: Active plans appear on the public pricing page; archived plans stay assignable by staff only.

empty.title: No plans in the catalog
empty.description: Create the first subscription plan to define what merchants can subscribe to on Rawafid.
empty.filterDescription: Try another status filter or create a new plan.

create.metaDescription: Add a new subscription plan to the Rawafid catalog with localized copy, tiers, and features.
create.title: Create subscription plan
create.subtitle: Define a plan code, bilingual copy, shipment volume tiers, and the feature matrix merchants will see.

basics.title: Plan identity
basics.description: Codes are permanent identifiers used in subscriptions and admin tools.
basics.codeHint: Uppercase letters, numbers, and underscores only — max 50 characters.
basics.codeImmutable: Plan codes cannot be changed after creation.

tiers.title: Pricing tiers
tiers.description: Each tier pairs a monthly shipment volume with explicit monthly and yearly prices.
tiers.cardDescription: Merchants pick a tier when subscribing. Yearly price is stored separately — not 12× monthly.
tiers.customPricingHint: Custom pricing plans have no tiers — merchants contact the platform team.

features.title: Feature matrix
features.description: Rows appear on the public pricing comparison table.
features.cardDescription: Each feature has a type that controls how it renders for merchants.
features.empty: No features yet — add rows to describe limits and capabilities.
features.unlimitedHint: Unlimited features need no extra value — they render as an unlimited badge.

validation.codeFormat: Use uppercase letters, numbers, and underscores only (max 50)
validation.sortOrder: Enter a valid sort order (0 or higher)
validation.tierPrice: Enter a valid price with up to 2 decimal places
validation.tiersRequired: Add at least one pricing tier, or enable custom pricing
validation.customPricingTiers: Custom pricing plans must not include tiers
validation.duplicateTierVolume: Each tier must have a unique shipment volume
validation.featureNumber: Enter a valid number for this feature
validation.featureEnabled: Choose whether this feature is included
validation.featureText: Enter display text for this feature

form.readOnlyHint: Your role can view plans but not edit them.

lifecycle.defaultHint: The default signup plan cannot be archived.
lifecycle.archiveDescription: {{name}} will disappear from the public pricing page. Existing subscriptions keep their snapshot.
lifecycle.activateDescription: {{name}} will return to the active catalog and can be assigned to companies again.

profile.title: User profile
profile.subtitle: Identity and contact details for this merchant account holder.
profile.workspaceDescription: This user belongs to one merchant company. Suspending them blocks login and revokes every active session immediately.

trust.title: Channel verification
trust.subtitle: Attest email and phone independently — the verified badge requires both channels.
trust.emailVerifiedHint: Mark when the email address has been confirmed by platform staff.
trust.phoneVerifiedHint: Mark when the phone number has been confirmed. Resets if the user changes their number.
trust.overallHint: The overall verified badge updates automatically when both email and phone are attested.

moderation.title: Account moderation
moderation.subtitle: Control whether this user can sign in to their merchant workspace.
moderation.activeDescription: This user can sign in and use the merchant dashboard. Suspending them blocks login and invalidates refresh tokens immediately.
moderation.suspendedDescription: This account is suspended — the user cannot sign in until reactivated.
moderation.suspendDescription: {{name}} will be blocked from signing in and all active sessions will end immediately.
moderation.reactivateDescription: {{name}} will be able to sign in again with their existing credentials.
